superVilain.modeDuoMeta: Taking turns, or each on your own phone
superVilain.relaisDebut: Answer the whole series, then pass the phone.
superVilain.relaisSuite: {{nom}} is done. Your turn, no peeking at their answers!
superVilain.jaugesTitre: What stands out in your answers
superVilain.modesDesc: The fifteen questions are the same. Solo, you find out which villain you're most like. As a couple, each of you answers separately and you compare your two portraits.
superVilain.modeDuoDesc: Taking turns on the same phone, or each on your own with remote mode.
superVilain.setupTitreSolo: Which supervillain are you most like?
superVilain.setupDescSolo: Your psychology, how you react under pressure, your villain gear: fifteen questions, and the supervillain you're most like, from the Joker to Maleficent.
superVilain.setupTitreDuo: Which villain is hiding in each of you?
superVilain.setupDescDuo: Enter your first names. The first player answers the fifteen questions, passes the phone, and the second answers in turn. Both portraits show up at the end, side by side.
superVilain.memePortrait: The same villain for both of you: the world doesn't stand a chance.
superVilain.portraitsDifferents: Two different villains: an alliance, or a war?
superVilain.noteFin: A Halloween quiz, just for fun. The characters belong to their creators, and nobody here is planning to conquer the world.
superVilain.p_joker_d: Chaos suits you. You laugh when everything's burning, you change plans every five minutes and you hate being taken seriously. In a relationship, you're exhausting and impossible to leave.
superVilain.p_joker_a: For Halloween, skip the makeup: it'd be too much. Let the others guess.
superVilain.p_harley_d: You love too much, too fast, too hard, and you say it with a baseball bat and glitter. You've forgiven unforgivable things, but you've also known when to leave. Unpredictable, funny, and dangerous when someone messes with your friends.
superVilain.p_harley_a: At Halloween, you pick the playlist. And nobody argues.
superVilain.p_loki_d: God of mischief: a double game, a third layer underneath, and a real need to be loved behind it all. You switch sides when it suits you, and you always end up making the right choice, at the last moment, as if by chance.
superVilain.p_loki_a: For Halloween, dress up as someone else. Nobody will know whether it's a costume.
superVilain.p_thanos_d: You have a plan, a logic, and the certainty of doing good for the greatest number. You're ready to sacrifice a lot, including what you love. Your friends call you “the reasonable one”, they don't know how much.
superVilain.p_thanos_a: At Halloween, hand out all the candy, not half. The kids wouldn't understand the balance.
superVilain.p_vador_d: Tall, dark, wounded. You chose power after a loss, and you wear your armour like mourning. But there's still good in you, especially when someone you love reaches out. In a relationship: intense, loyal, a bit dramatic.
superVilain.p_vador_a: For Halloween, the costume picks itself. Work on the breathing.
superVilain.p_voldemort_d: You want to last, to control everything, and for nobody to say your name without trembling. You're afraid of death and you hide it behind power. The people close to you find you cold, and they're not entirely wrong.
superVilain.p_voldemort_a: For Halloween, no mask needed: one look is enough. And leave your snake at home.
superVilain.p_malefique_d: Elegance, grudges and well-placed curses: you never forget a forgotten invitation. You're the most impressive person in the room, and you know it. Behind the horns, a heart that was betrayed once.
superVilain.p_malefique_a: At Halloween, arrive last, in the smoke. The entrance is everything.
superVilain.p_cruella_d: Style above all, luxury, and an obsession with one thing you want at any cost. You're demanding, spectacular, impossible to ignore. And you drive too fast.
superVilain.p_cruella_a: For Halloween, black and white, of course. But leave the dogs alone.
superVilain.q1: Your plan to conquer the world starts with...
superVilain.q1a: A big burst of laughter and a city turned upside down
superVilain.q1b: A chart, calculations, and the certainty it's for everyone's good
superVilain.q1c: An illusion: nobody will ever know what I really want
superVilain.q1d: A ceremony, followers, and a name nobody dares say anymore
superVilain.q2a: A black cape, a mask, and breathing that scares people
superVilain.q2b: A staff or a wand, and lots of magic
superVilain.q2c: A baseball bat and flashy colours
superVilain.q2d: A fur coat and a luxury car
superVilain.q3a: I laugh, and prepare a trick they'll remember
superVilain.q3b: I choke them with a look, from a distance
superVilain.q3c: I invite them to a party and curse them with a smile
superVilain.q3d: I forget them: they never mattered, only the goal matters
superVilain.q4a: My love for someone who doesn't deserve it
superVilain.q4b: My need to be loved by my family
superVilain.q4d: My obsession with one thing I want at any cost
superVilain.q5a: A castle on a cliff, with thorns everywhere
superVilain.q5c: A mansion with mirrors and furs
superVilain.q5d: An abandoned warehouse full of confetti
superVilain.q6a: The one who loves too much and says it with glitter
superVilain.q6b: The one who always has a double game going
superVilain.q6c: The one who'd sacrifice everything for the “balance” of the couple
superVilain.q6d: The one who's been mourning a lost love for twenty years
superVilain.q7: You're offered a power. Which one?
superVilain.q7a: Changing my face whenever I want
superVilain.q7b: Snapping my fingers and reorganising everything
superVilain.q8a: I burn it in front of everyone, for a laugh
superVilain.q8b: I flaunt it: furs, cars, and a cigarette holder
superVilain.q8c: I use it for a cause bigger than me
superVilain.q8d: I prefer power, money is for small people
superVilain.q9: Your enemies would describe you as...
superVilain.q10: Your way of making an entrance:
superVilain.q10b: In a cloud of green smoke
superVilain.q10c: With a smile that's anything but reassuring
superVilain.q10d: In a coat that costs as much as a house
superVilain.q11: What you do when you lose:
superVilain.q11a: I start over, differently, and laugh at the failure
superVilain.q11b: I withdraw, lick my wounds and come back stronger
superVilain.q11c: I pretend I lost: it was planned
superVilain.q11d: I make everyone pay, especially those who saw
superVilain.q13: A hero reaches out to save you. You...
superVilain.q13a: I take it, and betray him as soon as I can
superVilain.q13b: I take it: he's my son
superVilain.q13c: I refuse: I'd rather fall with panache
superVilain.q13d: I take it, to get closer to my goal
superVilain.q14a: Black and red, like a blade
superVilain.q14c: Black and white, half and half
superVilain.q15d: “I do what I want, and I do it with style.”
